sources.title: Qwen3-4B-Base — specs, VRAM, license, benchmarks | LocalLLMs
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3-4B-Base is an open-source large language model developed by Alibaba's Qwen research team, released in mid-2025 as part of the third generation of the Qwen series. The model excels at text generation and conversational tasks, offering strong performance for its parameter class with efficient inference capabilities.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities.
